name.fr-FR: Jansénisme VIII : Ordonnance et Instruction pastorale contre la Théologie de Châlons (1715)
name.en-US: Jansenism VIII: Ordinance and Pastoral Instruction against the Theology of Châlons (1715)
name.pt-BR: Jansenismo VIII: Ordenança e Instrução pastoral contra a Teologia de Châlons (1715)

author.fr-FR: François de Salignac de La Mothe-Fénelon
author.en-US: François de Salignac de La Mothe-Fénelon
author.pt-BR: François de Salignac de La Mothe-Fénelon

description.fr-FR: La dernière grande Instruction pastorale de Fénelon (1715) : la condamnation de la Théologie de Châlons (la Théologie morale du cardinal de Noailles), en trois parties.
description.en-US: Fénelon’s last great Pastoral Instruction (1715): the condemnation of the Theology of Châlons (the moral theology of Cardinal de Noailles’s diocese), in three parts.
description.pt-BR: A última grande Instrução pastoral de Fénelon (1715): a condenação da Teologia de Châlons, em três partes.

fr-FR.editor: J.-E.-A. Gosselin (éd. Saint-Sulpice), Paris: Leroux et Jouby / Gaume

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Fénelon, Paris, Leroux et Jouby, 1851 (éd. Gosselin, Saint-Sulpice), tome 5, p. 457–fin; archive.org OCR (ABBYY).
sources.description: Machine-cleaned OCR: running heads, page numbers and hyphenation removed, paragraphs rejoined, obvious character errors corrected by a vote against the corpus vocabulary; period spelling kept. Residual OCR errors remain (see PROBLEMS.md).
sources.tierEvidence: Fénelon died in 1715; the 1851 edition is public domain.
